scope: Source-audited review of 20 published European landscape identities; twelve attributable events for ten companies approved pending production rollback rehearsal.

sources.title: Scottish Enterprise confirms GBP950,000 support for Flowcopter

rounds.note_en: The GBP950,000 company-specific support is recorded as a grant. Scottish Enterprise also mentions GBP1.9m total investment in the company, but the residual amount is not split into attributable events and is not imported.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The 2024 Scottish Enterprise grant and 2026 TEKEVER acquisition are recorded; the reported GBP1.9m aggregate investment is not converted into a separate round.

sources.title: TEKEVER confirms its acquisition of Flowcopter

rounds.note_en: TEKEVER states that it acquired Flowcopter and that the Edinburgh engineering presence will continue under the TEKEVER brand; consideration and stake terms are undisclosed.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The 2024 Scottish Enterprise grant and 2026 TEKEVER acquisition are recorded; the reported GBP1.9m aggregate investment is not converted into a separate round.

sources.title: FLYDE reports EUR300,000 raised from business angels

rounds.note_en: The company reproduces a July 2026 interview stating that EUR300,000 had been raised from business angels to fund testing. The underlying closing date and angel identities are not disclosed; the disclosure date is used.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The retrospectively disclosed EUR300,000 angel funding and the 2026 Group Vanguard investment are recorded; exact closing dates and private terms remain unknown.

sources.title: BusinessMan reports Group Vanguard's investment and James Hogan becoming a FLYDE shareholder

rounds.note_en: The investment was made through James Hogan's family office, Group Vanguard Holdings. Amount and ownership percentage are undisclosed.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The retrospectively disclosed EUR300,000 angel funding and the 2026 Group Vanguard investment are recorded; exact closing dates and private terms remain unknown.

sources.title: ff Venture Capital announces its EUR4.5m investment in FlyFocus alongside NCBR NIF
Transaction counsel confirms FlyFocus's EUR4.5m first institutional round and investor roles

rounds.note_en: The round is described as FlyFocus's first institutional financing after eight years of self-financed growth. No individual contribution split is disclosed.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The 2026 EUR4.5m first institutional round is recorded; prior self-financing is not converted into an external event.

rounds.stage: Management buyout backed by Sud Rebond

sources.title: Connect Pro confirms the completed Flying Eye management buyout through Sud Rebond

rounds.note_en: The capital and operational transition was completed at the end of January 2024 and involved managers Simon Leroy and Jérémy Ladoucette plus a wider investor pool. Only the explicitly identified investment vehicle is structured; consideration and individual stakes are undisclosed.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The January 2024 management buyout is recorded with Sud Rebond as the identified backing vehicle; other pool members and transaction value remain undisclosed.

sources.title: Frequentis confirms IPO placement price and primary-versus-secondary share split
Frequentis H1 report confirms EUR21.6m gross proceeds from 1.2m new shares

rounds.note_en: Only the 1.2m new shares issued by Frequentis at EUR18 each are recorded as primary proceeds. The 1.8m existing/over-allotment shares sold from Johannes Bardach's holding are secondary and excluded.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The 2019 IPO primary issuance is recorded separately from secondary shareholder sales; earlier private ownership changes and later acquisitions made by Frequentis are not issuer financing.

sources.title: Freya Industries reports its oversubscribed SEK6m round
Unmanned Airspace identifies the Freya syndicate

rounds.note_en: The company describes the round as oversubscribed. Saminvest participated via Annexstruktur; selected private investors remain unnamed and are not inferred.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The September 2026 SEK6m seed round is recorded with the six publicly named participants.

sources.title: GDELS confirms General Dynamics acquired and renamed Santa Bárbara in 2001

rounds.note_en: The group history confirms continuity from Empresa Nacional Santa Bárbara to Santa Bárbara Sistemas within General Dynamics. Consideration and exact completion date are not disclosed on the checked source.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The 2001 General Dynamics acquisition is recorded with undisclosed consideration.

sources.title: Accordbank confirms USD5m financing for General Cherry

rounds.note_en: The bank announcement describes a USD5m credit agreement/financing facility for production expansion and contracts. It is debt, not equity, and no drawn-versus-undrawn split is disclosed.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The July 2026 USD5m Accordbank credit line is recorded; procurement revenue and contracts are not financing rounds.

sources.title: Germandrones and CONDOR announce a strategic capital increase
Germandrones identifies Cornelius Toussaint as investor and CFO since 2017

rounds.note_en: The capital increase was subscribed by CONDOR Group and the Germandrones management team. The amount, stake and individual management subscriptions are undisclosed; only the named corporate investor is structured.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The 2017 strategic capital increase is recorded with CONDOR Group; management subscriptions remain collectively described and undisclosed.

sources.title: Greenjets confirms USD40m Series A and named syndicate
NSSIF confirms Greenjets Series A participation and lead

rounds.note_en: Greenjets states that other existing investors also participated but does not name them; they are not inferred. Named roles are preserved exactly and no cheque split is claimed.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The July 2026 USD40m Series A is recorded with the explicitly named syndicate; unnamed existing investors remain undisclosed.
